==================
Private section
==================

Class Person
    name age
    func print
        see "Name : " + name + nl
    private
    salary = 15000
    func increasesalary x
        salary += x

==================
Operator overloading
==================

class point x y
    func operator cOperator,Para
        result = new point
        switch cOperator
        on "+"
            result.x = x + Para.x
        on "-"
            result.x = x - Para.x
        off
        return result

---

(source_file
  (class_definition
    name: (identifier)
    (expression_statement
      (identifier))
    (expression_statement
      (identifier))
    (function_definition
      name: (identifier)
      parameters: (param_list
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (expression_statement
        (assignment_expression
          (identifier)
          (new_expression
            (qualified_identifier
              (identifier)))))
      (switch_statement
        (identifier)
        (case_clause
          (string)
          (expression_statement
            (assignment_expression
              (member_expression
                (identifier)
                (identifier))
              (binary_expression
                (identifier)
                (member_expression
                  (identifier)
                  (identifier))))))
        (case_clause
          (string)
          (expression_statement
            (assignment_expression
              (member_expression
                (identifier)
                (identifier))
              (binary_expression
                (identifier)
                (member_expression
                  (identifier)
                  (identifier)))))))
      (return_statement
        (identifier)))))
